title: Theoretical Foundations of Computational Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh)
abstract: arXiv:2611.18593v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents the theoretical foundations and a comprehensive formal system for Computational Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh). We begin by establishing six foundational principles that distinguish computational Fiqh from conventional natural language processing and general theological formalization. These principles define Islamic jurisprudence as a normative deductive science operating on empirically grounded facts, necessitating a dual inductive-deductive methodology, and requiring a logical foundation specifically engineered for Fiqh rather than adopted from existing formalisms. translated_title: 计算伊斯兰法学（Fiqh）的理论基础
translated_abstract: 本文提出了计算伊斯兰法学的理论基础和一个完整的形式系统。我们首先确立了六项基础原则，以区分计算法学与传统的自然语言处理以及一般神学形式化。这些原则将伊斯兰法学定义为一门在经验性事实基础上运作的规范性演绎科学，要求采用归纳-演绎双重方法论，并且需要一个专门为法学设计的逻辑基础，而非沿用现有的形式化方法。基于这些原则，我们构建了一个三层分层的计算语言 $\mathcal{F} = D \circ A \circ G$，包括：（1）一个阿拉伯语形态/语法接地引擎，将完全标音的古典阿拉伯语转化为语言无关的接地动作结构（GAS）；（2）阿拉伯语具体化动作演算（ARAC）……
tldr: 本文为计算伊斯兰法学确立了六项基础原则，并构建了由阿拉伯语形态接地引擎和阿拉伯语具体化动作演算组成的三层分层计算语言形式系统。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes six foundational principles for Computational Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh) and constructs a three-layer stratified computational language comprising an Arabic Morphological/Grammatical Grounding Engine and the Arabic Reified Action Calculus.
